question_cn: 闪击战术的核心机制是什么？
question_en: What is the core mechanism of a discovered attack?

options.text_cn: 一步棋同时攻击对方的两个棋子
options.text_en: One move attacks two enemy pieces at the same time

options.text_cn: 移走己方一个棋子，暴露其身后另一个棋子的攻击线，使被遮挡的棋子突然威胁对方目标
options.text_en: Move one of your pieces to uncover an attack line from a piece behind it, suddenly threatening an enemy target

options.text_cn: 用一个棋子吃掉对方的保护者，让目标棋子失去防护
options.text_en: Capture an enemy defender so its target is left unprotected

options.text_cn: 牺牲棋子引诱对方棋子走到危险格，再利用叉将或将杀收割
options.text_en: Sacrifice a piece to lure an enemy onto a dangerous square, then exploit it with a fork or checkmate

explanation_cn: 闪击：前面的棋子一动，后方棋子的攻击线豁然贯通。本题Bxg7+象走开，车e4立即对准e8黑后——这就是闪击的全部逻辑。
explanation_en: In a discovered attack, a front piece moves and opens an attack line for a piece behind it. Here Bxg7+ moves the bishop away, revealing the rook on e4's attack on the black queen at e8.
